svg.title: WaterNet preprocessing pipeline — three-row snake layout
svg.desc: Row 1 gray: 3D Water Pattern Generation, Texture Filters, Light and Cam. Angle. Row 2 green: Standard Images, Motion Blur, Gaussian Blur. Row 3 purple: Scaling and Formatting, V Channel Isolation, CNN Input. Rows connected by right-side U-turn elbows.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What 3D noise algorithm generates the water pattern in WaterNet Blender synthesis?')
sendPrompt('What texture filters are applied to the synthetic water surface in WaterNet?')
sendPrompt('How does light and camera angle conditioning work in the WaterNet Blender pipeline?')
sendPrompt('What are standard images in the WaterNet pipeline and how do they differ from augmented variants?')
sendPrompt('What motion blur types are applied in WaterNet and how are kernel parameters calibrated?')
sendPrompt('What role does Gaussian blur play in WaterNet and what does it simulate?')
sendPrompt('How are WaterNet images scaled and formatted before feeding into the CNN?')
sendPrompt('Why is the HSV V channel isolated instead of grayscale in WaterNet?')
sendPrompt('What CNN architectures consume the preprocessed input in WaterNet?')
